summary.intent: Run the gsd-plan-phase orchestrator workflow end-to-end for CipherBox phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability and crash-resume soundness) — research the domain, resolve scope questions, and produce planner-ready CONTEXT/RESEARCH/VALIDATION artifacts before spawning the planner.
summary.outcome: Research pass 1 and 2 completed and committed, scope was expanded twice via user decisions (Rust engine.rs twin fixes, then folding in the previously-orphaned RotationDeps live-wiring todo plus its 4 bundled gate fixes), CONTEXT/ROADMAP/VALIDATION were updated and committed accordingly, but the session ended mid-flow while a third research extension (SQ7 live-wiring grounding) was still running in the background — the actual gsd-planner/gsd-plan-checker steps and PLAN.md generation had not yet run.

repo: CipherBox's plan-phase workflow never auto-commits PATTERNS.md after the pattern-mapper agent runs — must be committed explicitly by the orchestrator.
The plan:pre hooks `--raw` JSON output contains literal newlines inside string fragments, making it invalid strict JSON; must read the hook JSON file directly instead of parsing --raw output.

Intel API-SURFACE regeneration currently yields symbolCount=0 for this monorepo — its configured globs produce an empty surface, so the planner hint is a no-op and grounding must come from direct code reads.

crates/sdk/src/rotation/engine.rs is a full Rust twin of the TS rotation engine used by desktop FUSE/WinFsp, and shares (and compounds) the same depth-1-only dirty-frontier consumption bug as the TS engine.

The Rust rotation engine's production path fails closed: the only impl of RotationDeps in the workspace is the test FakeDeps (engine.rs:1533), so crates/fuse/src/write_ops/grant_scope.rs returns Err (EIO) today rather than silently skipping rotation — a deliberate deferred residual documented as 'LIVE-WIRING RESIDUAL' / ROT-07, referenced in the 69-13 SUMMARY.

There's an existing pending todo (.planning/todos/pending/2026-07-07-fuse-shared-scope-exit-rotation-live-wiring.md) tracking the RotationDeps live-wiring gap, bundled with a CRITICAL fail-open (empty sent-shares cache treated as private/no-rotation) and 3 MAJOR gate bugs (ancestor-walk fail-open, poisoned-lock panic, rename dest-gating/ordering) that become live revocation-bypass vectors once rotation is wired.
The per-rootNodeId job checkpoint plane deliberately documents 'never key material' as a boundary — the ECIES wrapped-key checkpoint (D-01) must fold into the per-nodeId high-water plane instead.
